items.prompt: Which state do only nouns take?
items.explanation: Nouns take rafʿ, naṣb and khafḍ, but no jazm; verbs take no khafḍ.

items.prompt: Which state do only verbs take?
items.explanation: Jazm belongs to the present tense, as in lam yanṣur.

items.prompt: What is the basic sign of naṣb?
items.explanation: Zaydan and lan yanṣura both end in fatḥa, the basic sign of naṣb.
